messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Medication and treatment and Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions in Rhineland-Palatinate during the 2000s and 2010s, matching this research need: Population health survey data on adult vaccination status, preventive screenings, health behaviors, cardiovascular and cancer risk perception, smoking, alcohol, diet, exercise, blood pressure knowledge, and sociodemographic characteristics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GEDA 2009 2010 2012 survey dataset vaccination screening smoking alcohol diet physical activity federal state Rheinland Pfalz RKI
